text:
sarah-partnerships: FYI CloudMarketplace just sent an update — they only allocated 60% of our reserved rack for Q3. They flagged an upstream SKU shuffle and say 40% will be delayed 2–3 weeks.
sarah-partnerships: This affects several Dedicated customers who pinned the reserved capacity. Need to decide reassign vs crediting.
kevin-sales: Oof. Which customers are hit? Can we pull exact reservation IDs?
maria-logistics: I have the PO<->reservation mapping. Quick list: RES-4432 (Acme), RES-4499 (DataCo), RES-4510 (SI pilot).
tom-ops: Can we surface which reservations are soft-commit vs hard-commit? We should honor hard commits first.
sarah-partnerships: CloudMarket says allocation was applied in alphabetical SKU buckets, not by commit tier — their staging cutover script failed.
jamie-engineering: Orionbot snapshot:

```
orionbot: commit_snapshot(1729999999) -> total_reserved: 240 GPUs
allocated: 144 GPUs (60%)
unallocated: 96 GPUs
hard_commits: 120 GPUs
soft_commits: 120 GPUs
```

jamie-engineering: Looks like hard_commits are partially filled.
tom-ops: Priority rule: allocate to hard_commits first, then oldest reservation. If partner mis-applied logic, we ask for immediate reallocation.
kevin-sales: Customer impact timeline? If delay confirmed 2–3 weeks we'll need to offer either a temporary burst (if we can), or pro-rated credits. Sales needs a clear playbook for messaging.
sarah-partnerships: Agreed. Proposed playbook: 1) Push partner to reallocate to hard_commits within 48h 2) If no reallocation, offer customers either (A) temporary capacity from burst pool (subject to availability) or (B) 10% pro-rated credit + SLA extension.
maria-logistics: Burst pool currently has ~32 GPUs available across regions (not all compatible with pinned hardware).
kevin-sales: For Acme it's sticky — they have compliance constraints, can't accept alternate region. We need to prioritize their RES-4432 for reallocation.
jamie-engineering: Actionable ask for CloudMarketplace: provide per-reservation allocation table + list of SKUs delayed + ETA per SKU. Also request a manual redistribution commit to honor our core hard_commits.
sarah-partnerships: I'll draft the partner message. LMK if you want to add specifics.
kevin-sales: Add a note about customer PII/regulatory blockers — call it out explicitly so partner doesn't try reassigning to other regions.
tom-ops: I'll start a dry-run reallocation script to check constraints. If partner can't reassign, we can fast-path some containers to burst pool.
maria-logistics: Timeline: partner says manifest update tomorrow 10:00 PT. If we get reallocation before EOD tomorrow, we can avoid credits.
kevin-sales: Please also pull the commit SLA tiers for each reservation (gold/silver/bronze) — we'll need to follow that for credits.
jamie-engineering: Noted. I'm adding an automated monitor to alert if partner allocation diverges by >5% from commit in the next 24h.
sarah-partnerships: Draft message to partner (will send after review):

```
Hi @cloudmarketplace-ops,
Thanks for the heads up. We see a 40% shortfall against our Q3 reserved pool. Requesting: 1) per-reservation allocation table with SKUs and ETAs, 2) manual reallocation to honor hard commits (RES IDs attached), 3) confirmation of carriage windows for delayed SKUs, and 4) contingency credits if ETA slips beyond 7 days.
Please reply with the table and estimated fix ETA. This is time-sensitive for customers in compliance stacks.
Thanks,
Sarah (Redwood Partnerships)
```

kevin-sales: That covers it. Can you attach RES IDs and SLA tier mapping in that email?
sarah-partnerships: Will do.
jamie-engineering: Quick note — if partner provides partial SKUs that are quantized (e.g., GPU v1 vs v2), we'll need to surface incompatibilities to customers ASAP.
maria-logistics: Action items: 1) Sarah send partner message (ASAP) 2) Tom run reallocation dry-run (today) 3) Jamie enable monitor (today) 4) Kevin prepare customer comms templates (draft by EOD) 5) Maria collect exact PO mapping and constraints.
sarah-partnerships: I'm sending now. cc @kevin-sales for messaging.

orionbot: message_posted(1729999999) -> thread created by sarah-partnerships

kevin-sales: Thanks — will stand by for the update. :thumbsup:
jamie-engineering: If partner refuses manual reallocation, dev team to propose temporary route: convert some soft_commits into burst-backed allocations with tenant-level firewalling to meet compliance (need approvals).
tom-ops: Keep me in loop for firewall/ops approvals.
maria-logistics: We'll reconvene at 10:30 PT after partner manifest arrives.
sarah-partnerships: Meeting invite up for 10:30 PT. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
